description: This file contains multiple utility functions related to handling SugarCRM/SuiteCRM beans over SOAP, including retrieving field lists, managing relationships, session and access checks, and data encoding/decoding. It provides core logic needed for SOAP-based web service interactions with the CRM data model.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of fields for a given SugarBean, including properties like name, type, label, options, default values, and special handling for certain modules.

methods.name: new_get_field_list
methods.description: Alternative method to retrieve module fields, including link fields, and handle module-specific adjustments.

methods.name: setFaultObject
methods.description: Sets a SOAP fault on the server object with provided error details.

methods.name: checkSessionAndModuleAccess
methods.description: Validates user session and module access permissions for SOAP requests.

methods.name: checkACLAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has ACL permissions for the given bean and view type.

methods.name: get_name_value
methods.description: Returns an associative array with name and value keys.

methods.name: get_user_module_list
methods.description: Returns a list of modules accessible to a user, with access levels.

methods.name: check_modules_access
methods.description: Checks if a user has specific module access (e.g., read/write) for a given module.

methods.name: get_name_value_list
methods.description: Creates a list of name-value pairs from a SugarBean's field definitions.

methods.name: filter_fields
methods.description: Filters list of fields to exclude invalid contact fields.

methods.name: get_name_value_list_for_fields
methods.description: Generates a name-value list for selected fields in a bean, respecting filters.

methods.name: array_get_name_value_list
methods.description: Converts an array to a list of name-value pairs.

methods.name: array_get_name_value_lists
methods.description: Converts an array into a list of name-value pairs, supporting nested arrays.

methods.name: name_value_lists_get_array
methods.description: Converts a name-value list into an associative array.

methods.name: array_get_return_value
methods.description: Builds a return value array including the ID, module name, and name-value list.

methods.name: get_return_value_for_fields
methods.description: Returns a structured representation of a bean for a specific module, filtered by fields.

methods.name: getRelationshipResults
methods.description: Fetches related records for a bean via relationship link field, returning rows and related fields.

methods.name: get_return_value_for_link_fields
methods.description: Retrieves related records for link fields in a bean, returning structured link data.

methods.name: new_handle_set_relationship
methods.description: Creates or updates relationship links between a primary bean and related IDs.

methods.name: new_handle_set_entries
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple bean entries based on name-value lists.

methods.name: get_return_value
methods.description: Creates a structured output for a bean, including ID, module, and name-value list.

methods.name: get_encoded_Value
methods.description: Escapes and encodes a value for XML inclusion.

methods.name: get_name_value_xml
methods.description: Generates XML for a name-value list for a bean.

methods.name: new_get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Returns module fields and link fields for a bean.

methods.name: get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Returns module fields and an error info array.

methods.name: get_return_error_value
methods.description: Creates an error value array with code, name, and description.

methods.name: filter_field_list
methods.description: Filters fields based on invalid contact field filters.

methods.name: filter_return_list
methods.description: Filters output list fields according to selected fields.

methods.name: login_success
methods.description: Initializes language and language strings after login.

methods.name: add_create_account
methods.description: Associates an account with a seed bean, creating the account if necessary.

methods.name: check_for_duplicate_contacts
methods.description: Checks for duplicate contact records based on email and name.

methods.name: is_server_version_greater
methods.description: Compares version arrays to determine if the server version is greater or equal.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Extracts and returns a specific file from a ZIP archive.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Retrieves the manifest.php file content from a ZIP upgrade package.

methods.name: get_encoded
methods.description: Base64-encodes a serialized object.

methods.name: get_decoded
methods.description: Decodes and unserializes a base64-encoded string into a PHP object.

methods.name: decrypt_string
methods.description: Decrypts a string using TripleDES with an optional key from settings.

methods.name: canViewPath
methods.description: Checks if a path is within a base directory (security check).

methods.name: apply_values
methods.description: Assigns a set of data values to a SugarBean object, with handling for first sync.
